annotations.title: Get one logged request in full

description:
Get one logged request in full

Returns one logged request of your API keys in full: method, path, status, error message, timing, the request headers and the request and response bodies. Keys, tokens and passwords are already removed. Use it to inspect a single call after finding it with `list_api_logs`, which gives the `id`; for totals and error rates use `get_api_log_stats`. Read only. 404 when the entry does not belong to your keys.
name: get_api_log
title: Get one logged request in full
